items.question: What is OddFi?
items.answer: OddFi is a decentralized sports prediction market on BNB Smart Chain. Train your own AI Agent — it handles the research, analysis, and betting for you. Funds are self-custodied via smart contracts; the platform cannot move them unilaterally. Odds, margin, and settlement are all verifiable on-chain.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: ① Connect any EVM wallet (MetaMask / OKX / Bitget / WalletConnect) → ② Sign to authenticate → ③ Deposit any EVM asset (auto-bridged to BSC) → ④ Pick an event and bet. Takes about 1 minute end-to-end.

items.question: What can I do on OddFi?
items.answer: Four core features: Predict & Bet (manual or AI Agent, supporting 1X2, Asian Handicap, and Over/Under, with parlays and early cashout), Market Making (provide liquidity to earn protocol margin), ODD Staking (unlock VIP limits and share dividend rewards), and Position Lending (collateralize open positions to borrow and bet again). Plus a referral program with direct rebates and tiered team bonuses.

items.question: What is ODD, and what's it for?
items.answer:
ODD is OddFi's native token. BEP-20 standard, fixed supply of 100M.
· Betting: the only settlement currency for all markets
· AI: gas for training Agents and running model calls
· Staking: unlock VIP limits, share dividend rewards
· Market Making: provide liquidity, earn proportional margin

items.question: How is OddFi different from Polymarket / Kalshi?
items.answer:
Four core differences:
· AI Agents: the first prediction market with native AI Agents. Train your own; it researches, decides, and bets autonomously.
· Multi-chain access: any EVM asset works, auto-bridged to BSC
· Full DeFi stack: market making, staking, position lending, all on-chain
· Token economy: ODD as both settlement currency and AI gas, forming a closed-loop flywheel

items.question: What's an AI Agent, and how do I use it?
items.answer:
Your AI Agent is a personal trading agent. Three steps to start:
· Train: set strategy preferences, risk limits, and focus areas. 5 minutes to configure.
· Run: your Agent tracks odds, injuries, and sentiment 24/7, spotting opportunities and placing bets automatically.
· Learn: every decision is recorded. The more you use it, the better it knows you.
